signature.name: Glance-to-meaning at 120px
signature.description: How quickly a half-awake customer, seeing the 120px loader for the first time, understands it means the coffee is being made, judged by a one-second glance test.

bare-wire.signature_why: At 120px I see a cup with a dark dot, but I could not say coffee is coming without a second look.
bare-wire.loved: The top-down cup with its handle reads as coffee, and the splash is calm and simple.
bare-wire.docked: The drop and heal are too subtle at 120px, so it reads as a static cup rather than a wait.

warm-hands.signature_why: A latte-art spiral in a cup says coffee at once, though the turn could pass for a spinner.
warm-hands.loved: A pour already in progress that never finishes makes the wait feel like someone is working on it.
warm-hands.docked: The stain and fine rings turn to mush at 120px, and the spiral could read as a spinner or a cinnamon roll.

the-glitch.signature_why: A cup under a falling drop with a counting row of dots says something is being made in one glance.
the-glitch.loved: The one-second drop and five-dot counter make the wait feel steady and countable, the easiest read at 120px.
the-glitch.docked: The band slip every loop looks like a rendering bug, which could make a tired customer wonder if the app is broken.
